title: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook: Histogram
use: Count/share/density histogram distinctions and normalization; original unequal-width example

title: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook: Scatter Plot
use: Paired-coordinate diagnostic, nonlinear patterns, changing spread and grouped displays
verification: Retrieved official method reference; inspected definition, diagnostic patterns and conditioning plots. Did not adopt its blanket implication from causality to observed association; chapter explicitly permits masking/cancellation.

verification: Retrieved official design guidance; inspected axis start, consistent scales and dual-axis sections. Publication preferences are distinguished from mathematical requirements; chapter independently derives log-scale meaning.

verification: Retrieved official visual guidance; inspected display and annotation sections. Did not adopt informal frequentist-probability wording or treat interval overlap as a test; chapter derives a direct difference interval under stated dependence.
